description: The Government is seeking to acquire commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) Brand Name Teledyne DVL Sensors and associated upgrades. To be considered acceptable and eligible for award, quotes must provide all of the items and quantities required within RFQ and associated attachments (See RFQ Attachment C1.5 ATTACHMENT (01) ITEM LIST for the full list of required Brand Name items). The Government will not consider quotes or offers for partial items or quantities. For more information pertaining to the solicitation, See RFQ Attachment C1.5 ATTACHMENT (00) RFQ N66001-26-Q-6087.
